rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an advantage, including one side of “pros and cons.”

example.english: The pro of this plan is that it saves money.
example.traditional: 呢個方案嘅好處係慳錢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ge3 hou2 cyu3 hai6 haan1 cin2

rows.note: Use this for someone exceptionally skilled at an activity, especially in an informal evaluation, rather than simply someone whose job is professional.

example.english: They're a real pro at gaming.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 daa2 gei1 gou1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a person who supports a proposal, idea, concept, or principle.

example.english: This idea has a committed pro.
example.traditional: 呢個理念有個好堅定嘅支持者。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lei5 nim6 jau5 go3 hou2 gin1 ding6 ge3 zi1 ci4 ze2

rows.note: Use this specifically for an athlete who plays sports professionally.

example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 zik1 jip6 wan6 dung6 jyun4
